Does LiveAgent offer a free trial? How much does LiveAgent cost? LiveAgent pricing starts at $15 per agent/month (billed annually) with multiple tiers available including Small, Medium, Large, and Enterprise plans — each adding more advanced features like call center, social channel integration, SLA, and dedicated support.

What communication channels are supported? LiveAgent supports email, live chat, phone (via built‑in call center), Facebook, X, Instagram, WhatsApp, Viber, Telegram contact forms, knowledge base, and more — all unified into one inbox so you never miss a conversation. Can I cancel or change my plan anytime?
Absolutely — you can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your plan anytime with no contracts, no setup fees, and flexible billing options.
